name: HeroChat
author: HeroChat

sections.description:
Add the HeroChat live chat widget to your WordPress website in seconds.

HeroChat helps you communicate with website visitors in real time and provide instant customer support.

Create a free HeroChat account here:

https://app.herochat.io

After installing the plugin, simply enter your HeroChat ID and enable the widget.

External services

This plugin connects to the HeroChat service at app.herochat.io to load and display the live chat widget on your website.

When the widget is enabled, the plugin loads a JavaScript file from app.herochat.io. This request includes your configured HeroChat ID and the current site language. As part of loading the external service, the visitor’s browser may also send technical data typically required for web requests, such as the visitor’s IP address, browser details, and referring page.

This service is provided by HeroChat and is required for the live chat functionality to work.

Terms of Service: https://app.herochat.io/terms-of-service.txt
Privacy Policy: [https://app.herochat.io/privacy-policy.txt
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress plugin directory.
  2. Go to Settings → HeroChat – Live Chat.
  3. Enter your HeroChat ID.
  4. Enable Display HeroChat Live Chat Widget.
  5. Save your settings.

Your live chat widget will now appear on your website.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my HeroChat ID?

You can find your HeroChat ID here:

https://app.herochat.io/account/?tab=installation

Do I need a HeroChat account?

Yes. You can create a free account at:

https://app.herochat.io
